name: Chrome windows and tabs on macOS

instructions.text: Chrome profiles keep browsing information separate. The Profile menu shows and switches profiles; use the identity required by the task and verify website account identity independently.
Chrome supports tab search and choosing an existing tab. If Flick supplies a tab list, select the observed tab by its title and URL, then verify the active page.
A tab context menu contains tab-management actions. Read the open menu before selecting an item; menu contents vary with the tab and window state.

Use the page’s observed controls for website work. Native Chrome observations are useful for the tab strip, profile menu, and system dialogs; returning to an already selected page is not progress by itself.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Flick browser/native driver distinction and observed-control contract; no website selector is embedded.

instructions.text: After navigation, choose the available wait action when the expected page or content is still loading. Verify title, URL, and relevant controls before retrying navigation or changing tabs.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Flick exposes wait_for_load and wait_for_change when applicable; suggested outcome-based recovery.

instructions.text: Retain exact text and the current milestone before changing tabs or apps. After switching, locate the destination control before pasting; a browser window alone does not identify the intended page.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Proposed cross-app and cross-tab focus check using retained task state.
